notes: Direct HTTP fetch (desktop Chrome UA) worked for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and all category/product pages; no block encountered, consistent with prior Home-Decor pass's access notes for this site. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: full sitemap.xml (6817 lines) grepped for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten tokens; the Homeware hub page's visible mega-menu category list (22 links: barware, bath-mats, bedding, bedroom-accessories, bedspreads, candle-holders, candles, diffusers, glassware, home-decor, home-fragrance, lighting, mirrors, mugs-cups, photo-frames, plant-pots, tableware, vases, wall-art, etc. - NO pet link present in the visible nav); breadcrumb JSON-LD on the category page itself. Found exactly one genuine Pet Care category: 'Pet Accessories' at /homeware/category/pet-accessories - it is NOT linked from the visible Homeware mega-menu (found only via sitemap.xml enumeration, same 'hidden but live' pattern the prior Lighting pass documented for Bedroom/Dining/Living Room Lighting), but is a real, live, indexed page with its own breadcrumb (Homeware > Pet Accessories) and its own rendered result-count button. It is a leaf category (no nested /pet-accessories/* sub-URLs found in the page HTML), so emitted as a single non-group row. Product hrefs on the page (verified via curl) are genuinely pet-specific: macrame pet leads, poop/treat bags, Tangle Teezer pet grooming brushes, pet hair removers, ceramic pet bowls (paw-print, 'Le Chien', 'Le Chat', cat-ear designs), ceramic pet treat/food jars, embroidered seagrass pet storage baskets ('Paws Off'/'Claws Off'), a pet gift set, and a dog-treat/biscuit product - this is a legitimate mixed mainstream Pet Care category (feeding, walking, grooming, hygiene, storage), not a pet-themed-for-humans page. A handful of items in the mix (greeting cards 'How to Speak Cat/Dog', 'Cat Lady' fridge magnets) are pet-themed novelty/gift items rather than pet-use products, but they are a minority within the site's own bundled category and there is no separate sub-URL to isolate them, so the site's own count is used as-is per the qty rule. One item found ('W'Zis Slipper Biscuit Refillable Dog Treats') is a pet consumable/treat bundled inside this mixed accessories category, not a standalone food category, so it did not trigger a standalone PET CONSUMABLE flag - noted here for visibility. Excluded per standing rules: gift/recipient hub pages 'gifts-for-cat-lovers' and 'gifts-for-dog-lovers' (human-facing gift marketing hubs, not real product categories); individual pet-themed products found loose in the sitemap outside any pet category (e.g. dog/cat-shaped paper clips, a whippet Christmas tree decoration, a 'Bon Appetit' wall art print) - pet-themed decor items, not pet-use products, correctly living in Wall Art/Gift categories, not Pet Care. No pet food/treat-only category or medical/veterinary category exists on this site.
